description: This file defines the 'DisplayFieldGroup' class, which represents a group of display fields in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as id, report group, name, list flag, and related selected display field groups, along with their corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: DisplayFieldGroup
classes.description: Entity class representing a display field group with properties for ID, associated report group, name, list indicator, and related selected display field groups.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the display field group.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the display field group.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the display field group.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the display field group.

methods.name: isList
methods.description: Indicates whether this display field group is marked as a list.

methods.name: setIsList
methods.description: Sets whether this display field group is marked as a list.
